stemMd: A cell measures 36 mm in a printed micrograph labelled as 1200 times actual size. What is its actual diameter?
explanationMd: Divide image size by magnification: 36/1200 = 0.03 mm. Since one millimetre contains 1000 micrometres, the cell is 30 micrometres across. Check that the actual cell is much smaller than its image.

distractorRationale.d: Actual size must be the 36 mm image size divided by 1200; 43.2 mm would even exceed the image size.
distractorRationale.a: This introduces an extra factor of ten.
